title: pyrus × fallax
intro: Pyrus × fallax, commonly known as the Daboecia × Pyrus or wild pear, is a hybrid plant species resulting from the cross between the Daboecia and Pyrus genera. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to support digestive health and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus × fallax include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
